description: The chart illustrates the number of hateful communication datasets released per year, broken down by language categories. The horizontal axis lists the categories as years from 2012 through 2022 in chronological order and is labeled “Year.” The vertical axis is labeled “Number of datasets” and uses a logarithmic scale with major tick marks shown at approximately \(10^0\), \(10^1\), and \(10^2\) (about 1, 10, and 100). For each year, multiple narrow vertical bars appear side-by-side (grouped by year) with colors corresponding to the legend titled “Language”: blue (unlabeled in the legend swatch but visually representing the main/overall series), orange (“All other”), green (“Arabic”), red (“Bengali”), purple (“Spanish”), and brown (“Russian”). Approximate bar heights by year are: 2012 blue ≈2; 2013 blue ≈2; 2014 blue ≈3; 2015 blue ≈3; 2016 blue ≈10 and orange ≈3; 2017 blue ≈22, orange ≈16, green ≈3, red ≈1, purple ≈4; 2018 blue ≈30, orange ≈12, green ≈5, red ≈1; 2019 blue ≈40, orange ≈20, green ≈4, red ≈2, purple ≈4, brown ≈6; 2020 blue ≈80, orange ≈75, green ≈7, red ≈4, purple ≈10, brown ≈9; 2021 blue ≈90, orange ≈40, red ≈13, purple ≈11, brown ≈9; and 2022 shows lighter-tinted bars (same category colors) at approximately blue ≈14, orange ≈16, green ≈3, and brown ≈1. The bars are not sorted by height within each year; they are arranged consistently by color/category, and there are no visible annotations or special emphasis beyond the legend and the lighter tint used for the 2022 bars.
